elements.requirement: The Landlord and Tenant Act 1985 applies to the Isles of Scilly subject to such exceptions, adaptations and modifications as the Secretary of State may direct by order.
elements.quote: This Act applies to the Isles of Scilly subject to such exceptions, adaptations and modifications as the Secretary of State may by order direct

elements.requirement: An order directing exceptions, adaptations and modifications for the Isles of Scilly must be made by statutory instrument.
elements.quote: An order shall be made by statutory instrument

elements.requirement: A statutory instrument containing an order under this provision is subject to annulment in pursuance of a resolution of either House of Parliament.
elements.quote: shall be subject to annulment in pursuance of a resolution of either House of Parliament
